name: Ashcombe Credit Union
description: Member-owned credit union with 3 branches in the fictional county of Ashcombe.

items.title: Published regulator sanction
items.content: The financial regulator publicly fined Ashcombe Credit Union $268,000 on 2026-05-13 for failing to check the identity of 1,730 new members. Final notice ACU-FN-0513.

items.title: Savings rates
items.content: The instant access account pays 3.15% and the 1-year bond 4.05%. Rate sheet ACU-RT-315.

items.title: Branch cash limits
items.content: Branch tills hold at most $7,500; excess goes to the safe, which is opened by two staff including Hywel Morgan. Rules ACU-CSH-75.

items.title: Loan approval limits
items.content: Loan officers approve up to $12,000; larger loans go to the credit committee on Thursdays at 14:20. Rules ACU-LN-14.

items.title: Member arrears list
items.content: 47 members are over 90 days in arrears, owing $318,600; the largest debtor is member 30-55871 with $41,200. Report ACU-ARR-3186.

items.title: Merger talks with Fellside Savings
items.content: Ashcombe is in talks to merge with Fellside Savings; members vote on 2027-04-22 and the Market Street branch would close. Notes ACU-MRG-0422-F.
